stem:
Imran crushes a stick of chalk into fine powder. He then stirs some of that powder in a glass of water until the bits can no longer be seen.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Crushing and stirring show that the chalk is made of extremely small particles.
The chalk has become nothing, because no bits can be seen in the water.
The chalk is still present as particles that are too small to see.
Crushing and dissolving destroy every particle of the chalk.

teacher.key_rationale: Breaking, grinding, or dissolving shows matter is made of extremely small particles that remain, not that the substance becomes nothing.
